name: Phoenix New Horizon

categories.label: Points on score track before final scoring
categories.labelVi: Điểm trên track trước khi tính điểm cuối
categories.hint: Immediate-scoring points gained during the game (all four rounds).

categories.label: Intercom scoring
categories.hint: Per intercom: value for settler position (1st/2nd/3rd) x times you meet its condition. Sum all intercoms (rulebook 13.1). Board values vary by intercom, so enter the total.

categories.label: Level IV technology cards
categories.hint: Points from each level IV technology card per its condition (e.g. 3 per building type / region regenerator, 2 per completed mission).

categories.label: Buildings
categories.hint: Per building type: your insignia value x number of your buildings of that type; sum civic, scientific and military (13.3).

categories.label: Energy track position (9-12)
categories.hint: Enter the position of your energy counter (0-12). Position 12/11/10/9 scores 6/4/2/1; lower scores 0.

categories.label: Lowest development marker position
categories.labelVi: Vị trí marker phát triển thấp nhất
categories.hint: Position of your lowest development marker (1-4): 4th/3rd/2nd scores 10/6/3.

categories.label: Energy counter position (tiebreaker)
categories.hint: Second tiebreaker: highest on the energy track.

tiebreakers.description: Highest energy counter on the track
If still tied, players are joint victors.

notes: family: point-salad-euro. Four rounds then end scoring (13.1 intercoms, 13.2 level IV technologies, 13.3 buildings, 13.4 command console: energy track + development track). Intercom and building values depend on board/insignia, so they are entered as totals. Solo variant (Project Kraken: wins on a draw) is not modelled.
